title: Sarlat Cathedral
source: Retained exact-QID OSM whole, current standard viewer PMTiles/DEM and four inspected exterior photographs.
identityStatus: Retained exact way/376197270 and Q2942447 identify Cathédrale Saint-Sacerdos. Current standard viewer PMTiles whole 35184748286102 and roof part 35185096439581 plus two small unlabeled touching north projections provide 130 raw outline points. The small projections are interpreted as exterior buttress feet, not independently identified buildings. Preserve the original anchor and heading -0.322408167209 rad. The high nave follows its oblique mapped roof within this native frame: longitudinal positive toward the northeast choir, negative toward the southwest tower-porch. Do not rotate the nave to native X or relocate it to the older reference POI. Separate neighboring town houses and the Lanterne des Morts remain host content.
axis: Oblique mapped nave, positive longitudinal axis toward northeast choir and negative toward southwest tower-porch.

reconstruction.heightBasis: No height, level or roof-height tags and no independent dimension facts. All heights are picture estimates above floor 0.5 m: low aisles and radiating chapels 10.5 m eaves / 13.5 m upper joins; high nave and polygonal choir 21 m eaves / 26 m ridge. Tower square body 30 m, flared lower slate cap 36.2 m, pinched upper bulb 44.3 m, open lantern 47.5 m, little cap 49.6 m and weather vane 51 m. Stair turret 23 m wall / 26.7 m cone. Internal component divisions, openings, flying buttresses, roof profiles, clock and simplified sculpture are estimates rather than measured architectural plans.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Sarlat exterior: irregular mapped aisles/chapels and attached south range; oblique high nave and polygonal choir; tall pointed glass, open flying buttress arches, round stair turret; Romanesque tower-porch with rectangular timber portal, blind arches, triple lights, paired louvered belfry lights, small clock and layered slate bulb roof/open lantern. Five shared texture graphs, four browser LODs. Fine sculpture and interiors simplified or excluded.
